claims.quote: Today the species has a circum-tropical distribution throughout the Indo-West Pacific region, e.g. Kenya, Australia, New Caledonia, Japan, Hawaii, the Comoro Islands, Indonesia, the Great Barrier Reef, the Palau Islands, Dzaoudzi, Pamanzi Island, the Seychelles and the South China Sea.
